caseNameFull: MERCER Et Al. v. HEMMINGS Et Al.
attorneys: Bruce Bromley, John H. Pickering, John R. Hupper, Hervey Yancey and Victor M. Earle III for appellants., Chester Bedell for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Stewart

is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case assigned for oral argument.
